command:
python - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

feature = json.loads(Path('feature.json').read_text())
assert feature['id'] == 'FNET-209'
assert feature['enabled'] is False
assert feature['integration'] == 'HOLD'
assert feature['depends_on_future_features'] == []
module = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['go', 'mod', 'edit', '-json'], text=True))
assert module['Module']['Path'] == 'github.com/djshellshoxxx/circula/future/federation'
expected = {
    ('github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4', 'v4.1.9', False),
    ('modernc.org/sqlite', 'v1.60.1', False),
    ('github.com/dustin/go-humanize', 'v1.0.1', True),
    ('github.com/google/uuid', 'v1.6.0', True),
    ('github.com/mattn/go-isatty', 'v0.0.24', True),
    ('github.com/ncruces/go-strftime', 'v1.0.0', True),
    ('github.com/remyoudompheng/bigfft', 'v0.0.0-20230129092748-24d4a6f8daec', True),
    ('golang.org/x/sys', 'v0.48.0', True),
    ('modernc.org/libc', 'v1.77.1', True),
    ('modernc.org/mathutil', 'v1.7.1', True),
    ('modernc.org/memory', 'v1.12.1', True),
}
actual = {(r['Path'], r['Version'], r.get('Indirect', False)) for r in module.get('Require', [])}
assert actual == expected, actual
assert not module.get('Replace')
assert not module.get('Exclude')
dependencies = set(subprocess.check_output(
    ['go', 'list', '-buildvcs=false', '-deps', '-test', '-f', '{{if .Module}}{{.Module.Path}}{{end}}', './...'],
    text=True,
).split())
allowed = {module['Module']['Path']} | {path for path, _, _ in expected}
assert dependencies <= allowed, dependencies - allowed
print('disabled/HOLD, exact recovered dependencies, and no core/other-feature imports: PASS')
PY
